category_title: Students with specialized home-based expertise who act as peer mentors
minimal_context: The student is participating in a weaving activity during art class.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Today in art class, we are studying weaving. Please begin working on the weaving assignment with your group.

STUDENT: My father taught me to weave purses!

TUTOR: That is nice. Let's just focus on the assignment.

STUDENT: I am the master weaver. I can be the team leader and assist the others in my group.

TUTOR: Please just do your own weaving right now.

STUDENT: But I am proud to tell you what my father taught me. I want to collaborate and assist the others with their weaving instead of just sitting here.

options.A: Prompt, model, role-play, and explicitly teach desired social-emotional behaviors, such as calming down when frustrated during the activity.
options.B: Implement a daily point system in art class, setting a goal for the student to earn 80% of possible points.
options.C: Arrange for the student to receive ongoing counseling from a Child and Youth Worker during the art activity.
options.D: Provide opportunities for the student to communicate their weaving knowledge through drawing, acting, or speaking during the activity.
